title: Signed Graph Pre-Training and Prompt Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.25722v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Signed graphs arise in trust--distrust networks, financial correlation systems, biological interaction graphs, and many other domains in which edges can be positive or negative and may also be directed. While signed graph neural networks have improved task-specific learning, graph transfer learning on signed graphs remains underdeveloped. In this paper, we introduce TopoSIGN, a pioneer topology-guided graph pre-training and prompt learning framework for signed graphs. TopoSIGN combines a structural encoder built on the magnetic signed Laplacian with a novel persistent-homology branch that summarizes signed topology through Dowker-complex persistence images. The fused embeddings are then transferred to a prompt learning function. translated_title: 符号图预训练与提示学习
translated_abstract: 符号图广泛存在于信任-不信任网络、金融关联系统、生物交互图等众多领域中，在这些领域中，边可以为正或为负，并且可能是有向的。虽然符号图神经网络已经改进了特定任务的学习，但符号图上的图迁移学习仍然发展不足。在本文中，我们提出了TopoSIGN，这是一个开创性的拓扑引导的符号图预训练与提示学习框架。TopoSIGN将基于磁符号拉普拉斯算子构建的结构编码器与一个新颖的持续同调分支相结合，后者通过Dowker复形持久图像来概括符号拓扑信息。融合后的嵌入随后被传递给提示学习函数。在合成数据集和真实数据集上的实验结果证明了TopoSIGN在提取符号图中有用结构信息方面的有效性，以及提示学习方法的适应性和灵活性。
tldr: 本文提出了首个拓扑引导的符号图预训练与提示学习框架TopoSIGN，通过融合磁符号拉普拉斯结构编码器与基于Dowker复形持久同调的拓扑分支，实现了符号图上有效的迁移学习。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TopoSIGN, the first topology-guided pre-training and prompt learning framework for signed graphs, which fuses a magnetic signed Laplacian structural encoder with a persistent-homology branch based on Dowker-complex persistence images to enable effective transfer learning on signed graphs.
